### ① Derived judgments

- `SKILL.md` 〈路径分叉〉, ① rewritten 「席位记录一条落 PR,两层同欠:Tier H 置顶速读五段,其下 `## 席位核对`;卡只留指针行」, the pointer line 「指针 `ACCEPT → PR #n comment <id>`;技能面 hunk 须由契约复审档的席复核,档外席先交 skills 席」 and the six-item line 「核对六项(席位读此):形态/前提实测/门禁 check-runs/接受的偏差/范围外去向/落地条款」 — the card's change 1 (the ACCEPT and the 终稿 are one PR comment: the five 速读 sections on top, then `## 席位核对` with what the ACCEPT carries today; the card gets one pointer line). Correct; the record is owed by both governed tiers, the 速读 half only where a maintainer must read before approving (Tier H), which is the dispatch's reading of the card and the maintainer's word. ② rewritten 「PR 悬着等人批,同笔挂 `needs-user-decision`;人工直合即审核记录,授权批准 ⇒ 席位落地」 keeps its two terminals and absorbs the label clause of the deleted 看得见 line; the 终稿 line now reads 「…填席位意见,置顶席位记录;维护者只读评论」. Correct. 速读五段 and 草稿归 dev are byte-identical.
- `landing-operations.md`, inserted after the two-reading sentence: 「落地评论 = 两个读数的探针表 + 一行状态变更(摘标/关卡/收口),⛔ 不复述 `## 席位核对`」 — the card's change 2 (the landing record stays the probe table on `origin/main` plus the one-line state change; no restatement of the ACCEPT). Correct, and placed beside the probe it names (「确认 MERGED 要两个读数」).
- `lanes/director.md` 职责一, inserted: 「摘要台账每场收工一块,⛔ 不逐落地写块;一次落地的记录 = PR 席位记录 + 落地探针表」 — the card's change 3. Correct, and it does not restate `SKILL.md` L236's four ledger items (卡、权威、方向、状态转移).
- `seat-lifecycle.md:33` 「写侧刷新点 = 轮次边界;中途状态由卡上 claim 评论与指针行、PR 上 `## 席位核对` 承载」 — the one sentence that would have gone false once the ACCEPT lives on the PR; amended in place. Correct.
- Deletions, read against `main`: `SKILL.md` old L202 「已入队 ⇒ 转 draft 并 disable,即请维护者手动出队(席位无实测手段);出队以阳性探针答」 is carried by `AGENTS.md` Prime Directive #14 (L291 「Already armed or queued when you read this? Disable auto-merge AND convert it back to draft…」) and `platform-readings.md:42–44` (the draft/disable readings and 「出队按队列 ref 阳性探针答不在队向」); `landing-operations.md` old L57 「窗口自身权责不变:跟到 MERGED、踢出处置、落地后对账」 is the file's section-B heading plus L27 (踢出处置), L49 (the three duties) and L73 (落地后对账). The three dropped SKILL.md clauses (「复核结论照常写在 issue 上」, 「贴终稿「维护者速读」评论」, 「①仍是审核记录」) are the rule this card replaces, not restatements. Nothing a seat still owes leaves the files.
- Nothing machine-read moves: `record-recognisers.mjs` `locateReviewOfRecord` accepts only a `## Contract review` heading comment naming the head, and its self-test pins a seat's ACCEPT paragraph as `absent`; `check-half-states.mjs` H36 reads `pr.draft === false || pr.auto_merge != null`; `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` exit 0 on the head (312 cases). The `## Contract review` record is untouched, as the card requires.
- Ratchet on the head: `SKILL.md` 319/319, `landing-operations.md` 101/101, `lanes/director.md` 66/72, `seat-lifecycle.md` 96/96; widest changed line 119 bytes; the four-axis block L241–261 (md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`), L95 and L108 untouched. `Lint & Repo Gates` (ratchet, id lint, governed-prose scan, `check:skill-frame-sync`) `success` on the head. `Fixes #23381` is the body's only closing keyword (#23352, #23377, #23379, #23380, #23389, #23396, #23405, #23414 carry no closing verb); `Clause-②: no` is correct — internal protocol text, no published surface.
- Deviation from the dispatch, accepted: the ① line sits at L188 on `b5b1bf7277` (the dispatch said L187–193; L187 is the >3000-line rule, untouched); the seventh line of the block is paid by a same-file deletion outside L188–193 (old L202), inside the same section, as the dispatch allowed.
